verdict.reasons: Core defects: The commercial family is incorrectly identified as 'hose' due to the visual appearance of the installed lines. While the main product (AFP carton roll) is the correct tape20 reference, the thin black laterals running along the seedlings have a 3D cylindrical cross-section and uniform pipe texture, visually reading as 1/2-inch micro-tube or round hose rather than flattened polyethylene drip tape. Additionally, the technical evidence for 'monitoring' is missing the required visual cue of a continuous dark wet-soil strip along the root zone; the soil is uniformly dry and brown. The placement feedback requests the carton be moved to the lower-left with lines to its right (preventing overlap); the current geometry violates this spacing constraint.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
